faqs.question: Where do I go for a project?
faqs.answer: Projects will be always be in the Engineering Building A. It will typically in the same room each week, although changes will be announced on our Instagram.

faqs.question: I just want to join for the socials!
faqs.answer: No problem! You don't have to do a project to be a part of the society. Keep updated on our events on our [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/uom_robosoc/).
